candidates.change_summary: Delete the statement `acc.balance += msg.value;` so the caller's deposited balance is never updated.
Replace `acc.balance += msg.value;` with `acc.balance = msg.value;` so the deposit overwrites rather than accumulates the balance.
Replace the ternary unlock-time assignment with `acc.unlockTime = _unlockTime;` so an unlockTime in the past is no longer clamped to block.timestamp.
Delete the unlock-time assignment so the stored unlockTime is never updated by a Put call.
Change the balance check from acc.balance>=_am to acc.balance>_am so withdrawal of the exact balance is rejected.
Delete the else {revert();} branch so a failed ETH transfer silently deducts the balance without sending funds.
Send the whole remaining balance acc.balance instead of _am in the external call.
Delete the balance update so Collect sends funds without deducting them from the caller's balance.
Remove the MinSum requirement from the withdrawal condition so small-balance accounts can withdraw.
Move the balance deduction after the external call so reentrancy sees the pre-deduction balance.
Change the unlockTime check to block.timestamp<=acc.unlockTime so withdrawals are only allowed before the unlock time.
Delete the statement `acc.balance += msg.value;` so deposits no longer increase the holder's balance.
Replace `acc.balance += msg.value;` with `acc.balance = msg.value;` so each deposit overwrites rather than accumulates the balance.
Replace the unlockTime assignment with `acc.unlockTime = _unlockTime;` so a past _unlockTime is stored instead of block.timestamp.
Replace the unlockTime assignment with `acc.unlockTime = block.timestamp;` so a future _unlockTime is ignored.
Delete the unlockTime assignment so acc.unlockTime is never updated and stays 0.
Delete the LogFile.AddMessage(msg.sender,_am,"Collect") call so no Collect log entry is recorded.
Log amount 0 instead of _am in the Collect log entry.
Invert the success check so a successful transfer reverts and a failed one logs the Collect message.
Log the contract's own address instead of msg.sender as the Collect sender.
